offline.title: Can't reach Wokko
offline.text: The server isn't responding. Your recipes aren't affected. Check that it's running, then try again.
notfound.title: Nothing here
notfound.text: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
setup.title: Welcome to Wokko
setup.subtitle: Create the admin account to get started.
auth.handle_hint: 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. People need it to share with you.
auth.no_account: Have an invite? Create an account
auth.have_account: Already have an account? Log in
auth.forgot_hint: Forgot your password? Ask your admin for a reset link.
auth.invite_required: This server is invite-only. Ask its admin for an invite.
auth.invite_optional: Optional. Use one to join a household.
reset.title: Choose a new password
recipes.empty_text: Add your first recipe. It's saved on your own server.
insights.title: Kitchen knowledge
insights.hint: Worked out by Wokko from the ingredients and steps. If allergies matter, always check the labels.
insights.may_contain: May contain, depending on the product:
insights.unknown: Wokko doesn't know these yet, so they aren't counted: {foods}
editor.name: Name
editor.photo_failed: Recipe saved, but the photo wasn't: {reason}
editor.conflict_hint: Your changes aren't lost. Look at the latest version, or replace it with yours. The other version stays in the recipe's history.
visibility.private_hint: Plus anyone you share it with below.
visibility.household_hint: Household members can see and edit it.
visibility.public_hint: Anyone can see it, without logging in.
share.title: Share recipe
share.with_person_hint: They can read it, not change it. Enter their complete handle: people can't be searched.
share.links_hint: Anyone with the link can see this recipe, without an account.
share.link_gone_hint: It may have expired or been deleted.
gallery.title: Public recipes
trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Deleted recipes stay here for 30 days, then they're removed for good.
trash.purge_confirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? This can't be undone, except from a backup.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.aliases_hint: Separated by commas. These are found in search too.
catalog.read_only: Only an admin or whoever created this entry can change it.
catalog.merge_hint: Recipes using “{name}” will use the entry you choose, and this one is removed.
people.friends_hint: Nobody can find you by searching. To connect, tell each other your exact handles.
people.household_hint: Everyone here shares recipes, unless a recipe is set to “Only me”.
people.invite_hint: Works once, for 7 days. It's only shown now, so copy it.
settings.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were logged out.
settings.export_hint: A ZIP file with recipes and photos, readable without Wokko.
admin.all_good: Everything looks good. Backups are current and the database passed its check.
admin.warn_integrity: The database check found a problem: {reason}. Restore the newest backup.
admin.warn_backup_overdue: Backups have stopped. The last good one is from {date}.
admin.warn_missing_photos_one: {count} recipe photo is missing from the disk.
admin.warn_missing_photos_other: {count} recipe photos are missing from the disk.
admin.link_once: It's only shown now, so copy it.
admin.open_registration_hint: Anyone who can reach this server can create an account.
admin.allow_public_hint: Allow recipes to be public and show the public gallery.
admin.delete_confirm: Delete this account? Their sessions and friendships are removed.
admin.delete_has_recipes: This user owns recipes. Choose what happens to them.
admin.delete_with_recipes: Delete user and all their recipes
err.network: Can't reach the server. Nothing was saved, so please try again.
err.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Your data was not changed.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
err.edit_conflict: Someone changed this recipe while you were editing.
err.bad_request: The request could not be read.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
err.bad_handle: Handles have 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
err.invite_required: Registration is invite-only. Please enter your invite code.
err.invalid_invite: This invite is invalid, expired or already used.
err.invalid_reset: This link is invalid or has expired.
err.cannot_delete_self: You can't delete your own account.
err.bad_target: The user to receive the recipes doesn't exist.
err.user_has_recipes: This user owns recipes. Choose what happens to them.
err.handle_not_found: No user has exactly this handle.
err.in_use: Recipes still use this. Merge it into another entry instead.
err.bad_url: The source must be a web address.
err.unknown_food: An ingredient in this recipe no longer exists.
err.unknown_unit: A unit in this recipe no longer exists.
err.public_disabled: Public recipes are turned off on this server.
err.not_in_trash: Move this recipe to the trash first.
err.invalid_image: Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo no larger than 20 MB.
err.backup_failed: The backup failed. Check the backup folder and free space.
import.title: Import a recipe
import.hint: Paste a link from a recipe site or blog. You can check everything before saving.
import.text_placeholder:
Name of the recipe

Ingredients
200 g flour
2 eggs

Instructions
Mix everything…
import.done: Imported. Please check it, then save.
import.guessed: This site publishes no recipe data, so Wokko read it from the page. Please check it closely.
import.split_hint: All ingredients start in step 1. Move them if you like.
err.import_empty: Enter a link or paste a recipe.
err.import_bad_url: That doesn't look like a web address.
err.import_private: Wokko only imports from public websites.
err.import_blocked: This site doesn't allow automatic imports. Copy the recipe's text and paste it here instead.
err.import_unreachable: That site couldn't be reached. Check the link, or paste the recipe's text instead.
err.import_not_page: That address isn't a recipe page.
err.import_no_recipe: No recipe found there. Copy the recipe's text and paste it here instead.
err.import_too_long: This text is too long to import.
palette.placeholder: Search recipes, or type a command
plan.title: Meal plan
plan.add_to_shopping: Add the ingredients to the shopping list
err.plan_empty: Choose a recipe or enter a title.
shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.add_placeholder: Add an item, such as 2 kg potatoes
shopping.empty_text: Add items here, or from a recipe or your meal plan.
shopping.aisles_hint: Aisles sort your list. A shop can walk them in its own order.
books.title: Recipe books
books.empty_text: Group recipes for weeknights, holidays or anything else. Your household sees them too.
books.name: Name
books.empty_book: This book is empty. Add recipes from their page.
books.delete_hint: Deleting a book keeps its recipes.
recipe.nutrition_partial: Based on {counted} of {total} ingredients. Not counted: {names}.
recipe.nutrition_estimate: Estimates from USDA data and your ingredient list.
recipe.nutrition_none: No nutrition data for these ingredients yet.
history.title: Version history
history.empty: No earlier versions yet. One is kept each time this recipe is saved.
history.restored: Restored. The version it replaced stays in the history.
settings.collection_hint: Anyone with this link can see every recipe you haven't set to “Only me”. Your name isn't shown.
shared.title: Shared recipes
passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.hint: Log in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password.
passkey.name: Name for this passkey
passkey.needs_https: Passkeys need HTTPS. Set up HTTPS for this server to use them.
err.passkey_failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
assistant.title: AI assistants (MCP)
assistant.hint: Let an AI assistant read and manage your recipes through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It can never do more than you can, and everything it changes can be undone.
assistant.off: An admin needs to turn this on first.
assistant.off_admin: Turn this on in the admin settings first.
assistant.name: Name
assistant.scope_delete: Read, change and move to trash
assistant.secret_hint: It's filled in below, and shown only once.
assistant.new_entries_never_hint: Assistants have to use ingredients and units that already exist. A recipe with an unknown one isn't saved, and the assistant is shown close matches instead.
assistant.new_entries_ask_hint: Assistants look for existing ingredients and units first. Anything new is only added after the assistant has asked you.
assistant.new_entries_allow_hint: Unknown ingredients and units are added to the catalog, just like when you type them in the editor.
assistant.activity_empty: Nothing changed by an assistant yet.
admin.mcp_hint: Lets people connect assistants to their own recipes. Each person still has to create a token or approve an app.
oauth.title: Allow access?
oauth.intro: {name} wants to use Wokko as you.
oauth.scope_read: Read your recipes, meal plans and shopping list
oauth.scope_write: Read and change your recipes, meal plans and shopping list
oauth.scope_delete: Read and change them, and move recipes to the trash
oauth.never: It can't see other people's private recipes, find users, make recipes public or delete anything for good.
oauth.after: You'll be sent back to {host}. You can change this by removing access under Integrations and connecting again.
oauth.invalid: This request isn't valid. Please start again from the app.
err.invalid_client: This app isn't known. Please start again from the app.
err.invalid_redirect_uri: This app's return address isn't allowed.
err.invalid_request: This app didn't use a secure sign-in.
plan.week_already: This week's recipes are already on the list
offline.bar: You're offline. Saved recipes still open, and shopping changes are sent when you're back.
offline.waiting_one: {count} shopping change waiting to be sent
offline.waiting_other: {count} shopping changes waiting to be sent
fileimport.title: Bring in your recipes
fileimport.from_file_hint: Files exported from another Wokko, exports from Tandoor, Mealie and Paprika, or schema.org recipe files such as Nextcloud Cookbook's. You'll see what's inside before anything is saved.
fileimport.private: Imported recipes start as “Only me”. Recipes you already have are skipped.
fileimport.bookmark_hint: Save this as a browser bookmark. Pressing it on a recipe page sends that page here.
fileimport.phone_hint: Add Wokko to your home screen from the browser's menu. It then appears when you share a page from any app.
fileimport.phone_needs_https: Sharing from your phone needs Wokko on HTTPS, and so does offline use. The README explains how to set that up.
err.import_file_unknown: No recipes found in this file. Wokko reads exports from Tandoor, Mealie and Paprika, and schema.org recipe files.
err.import_file_too_big: This file is too big to import.
err.bad_new_entries: Choose don't allow, ask me or allow.
err.new_entries_not_allowed: Assistants may not add new ingredients or units.
err.new_entries_need_confirmation: New ingredients or units need your confirmation first.
integrations.hint: Bring recipes in from other apps and websites, take them out again, and connect AI assistants.
assistant.claude_1: Choose “Add to Claude”, or in Claude open Settings, then Connectors, and choose “Add custom connector” with the address below.
assistant.claude_2: Check that the name is Wokko and the address is right, then add it.
assistant.claude_3: Choose Connect, log in to Wokko when it opens, and allow access. It then works in Claude on the web, on your computer and on your phone.
assistant.chatgpt_1: In ChatGPT, open Settings, then Apps & Connectors, and turn on developer mode under the advanced settings. Not every plan has it.
assistant.chatgpt_2: Create a connector with the address below, and choose OAuth as authentication.
assistant.chatgpt_3: Log in to Wokko when it opens, and allow access. Then turn the connector on in a chat.
assistant.claude_code_1: Create a token, then run the command in a terminal.
assistant.codex_1: Create a token, then run the commands in a terminal. Codex reads the token from WOKKO_TOKEN, so set that in your shell profile too.
assistant.gemini_1: Create a token, then run the command in a terminal.
assistant.cursor_1: Create a token, then choose “Add to Cursor”. Or add the setup below to ~/.cursor/mcp.json, next to any servers already there, and restart Cursor.
assistant.other_1: Apps that add a connector by address and log in by themselves need only the address.
assistant.other_2: Others need the address and this header, with a token you create here.
assistant.needs_https: This needs Wokko on HTTPS and reachable from the internet. It isn't right now, so choose an app that uses a token instead.
assistant.setup_local: Apps that start a local MCP server
assistant.setup_local_hint: Such as Claude Desktop without a connector. This works on the computer that runs Wokko.
assistant.or_by_hand: Or set it up by hand:
assistant.vscode_1: Create a token, then choose “Add to VS Code”. Or add the setup below to .vscode/mcp.json in your project.
assistant.openclaw_1: Create a token, then add this to ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json, merging it with what's there. OpenClaw can also log in by itself: see its guide.
assistant.hermes_1: Create a token, then add this to ~/.hermes/config.yaml, next to any servers already there.
export.title: Export this recipe
export.hint: Download it as a file, to bring into another Wokko or another recipe app.
export.wokko_hint: Keeps everything, including which ingredients belong to each step.
export.schema_hint: schema.org files, which Tandoor, Mealie, Nextcloud Cookbook and others import.
export.scope_all_hint: Yours, your household's and recipes shared with you. To move a whole server, use a backup instead.
export.formats_hint: “For another Wokko” keeps everything. “For other apps” gives schema.org files, which Tandoor, Mealie, Nextcloud Cookbook and others import.
catalog.title: Starter catalog updates
catalog.hint: New Wokko versions can bring more foods, translations and corrected nutrition values. Entries nobody changed are updated on their own. Where someone changed a value that the update changes too, or where an entry belongs to a person, you decide here. Nothing is ever deleted.
catalog.last: Last update {date} with version {version}: {added} added, {updated} updated.
